utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard anything about the repair drive Faye is organizing? I'm helping with the schedule but keep missing the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yes, the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Leo is bringing the tools and Rosa has the list of households that requested repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, thanks Mara! I was worried I'd miss the start time. I'll make sure to be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, the repair drive is this Saturday! Leo's bringing his tool kit, and Noah's got duct tape, screws, and a hammer. You in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm in! Mara's bringing tools too, and Sam and Ira are helping out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, glad to have you! Let's make sure everyone knows—I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I'll probably be a bit late on Saturday, but I'll definitely make it to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Dane! I'll have the sign-out sheet ready for when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus. I'll grab a slot on the sheet as soon as I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I brought my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Leo! Is Uli coming too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not sure about Uli.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So both Ira and Mrs. Chen vouch for it? That's reassuring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did Gus log the sign-out sheet for that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm not sure about Gus's sign-out sheet. Did he mention anything about it to you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, I've got duct tape, screws, a hammer, and some snacks for the volunteers—want me to bring the rake for Dane too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Noah already brought duct tape, screws, and hammer, so we're good on those. But the rake could be useful for Dane—sure, bring it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll bring the rake then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What tools are still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Noah brought duct tape, screws, and a hammer; Leo is bringing his tool kit. So far so good.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What about Jules? Is he bringing anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So we're all set for Sunday at the community center? I want to make sure we have enough time to set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, it's on Saturday, not Sunday. Gus is bringing tools with a sign-out sheet, and Faye's got snacks for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are you sure? I thought it was definitely Sunday. I even scheduled my whole afternoon around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Ira, are you ready for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Almost! I saw Gus getting his tools ready, and Jules said she'd drop by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, sounds like we're all set. I'll be there early, and I also promised Oren I'd help with his fence afterward.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So the repair drive is this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yep, Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I heard Sam might be helping but he has that fence with Oren.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The repair drive's on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Saturday. Gus is bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Alright, good. I'll be there around nine.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I heard Gus is bringing tools and Noah's got duct tape and screws.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Tess, the drive is actually on Sunday! But yes, I'll be there with the sign-up sheet. Gus has the tools ready too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I thought it was Saturday! But no, you're right, it's Sunday. I'll bring my wobbly porch chair, maybe Noah can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Vik, Noah already added duct tape, screws, and a hammer to the toolbox. Are you bringing anything else for Saturday's drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think we're all set—Mara's bringing tools, Sam and Ira will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Don't forget Gus and Leo are bringing their tools too—that should cover everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, that's on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that's right, Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I'll try to swing by with my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Gus is bringing tools, right? That's good.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, and Noah dropped off some supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Saturday should be all set then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, just confirming the repair drive is this Saturday, I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Saturday at the community center. I have everything noted, including Noah's supplies and Gus's tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, glad that's all in order. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I saw Gus gathering his tools earlier, and I think Jules mentioned stopping by after lunch. Should be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did you see Gus with the sign-out sheet? I want to make sure everything's tracked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I didn't see the sheet, but Gus usually has everything organized. Maybe check with him?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I've got the schedule all set for Saturday, and I'll bring snacks and tools. Does that work for you, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you need me to bring anything besides what Noah already brought?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think we're good—Noah brought a lot, and I've got the rest covered. Just bring yourself!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'll probably be late on Saturday, but Quinn's saving a rake for me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, Noah brought duct tape, screws, and a hammer. Leo's bringing his tool kit too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, sounds like we'll have plenty of tools. Gus is making a sign-out sheet too, so we can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll bring my toolbox to the repair drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it's this Saturday? I heard it might be postponed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I've got it marked on my calendar as Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, did you hear about the repair drive on Saturday? Leo's bringing his tool kit and Noah's got the duct tape and screws—it's gonna be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great! I'm bringing some extra tools, and Vik's helping organize it. Gus has the tools sorted too, so we should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, sounds like we've got a solid team! Let's spread the word to make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't forget, the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Leo's bringing tools, and Rosa has the list of households.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Mara, I thought it was Saturday—and Gus is bringing tools, not Leo. Plus, Uli's gate is sticking, and my porch chair's wobbly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm sure it's Sunday, not Saturday, and Leo said he'd bring the tools. But I'll note Uli's gate and your wobbly chair for Rosa's list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: So the repair drive is this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Oren, it's this Sunday at the community center! I've got the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Sunday! I keep mixing up my days. Thanks for setting me straight, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is on Saturday now. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Saturday it is.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, that works for me. I'm glad Sam and Gus are on board.
